Sitemap_collections_1.xml surfaced several clearance/sale-worded handles; each was opened and checked for a strict clearance/outlet/last-chance signal in its own title/H1 copy: (1) clearance-sale -> <title>Nestasia Sale Online 2026 - Stock Clearance Sale</title>, H1 'Clearance Sale Upto 70% Off' -- consistent clearance wording, INCLUDED. (2) last-piece-clearance -> <title>Stock Clearance Sale - Home Decor Clearance Sale Online | Nestasia</title> -- 'last piece' = end-of-line framing, INCLUDED. (3) last-chance-clearance -> <title>Last Chance Clearance | Nestasia</title> -- direct target-term match, INCLUDED. (4) clearance-sale-1 -> <title>Exclusive Clearance Sale: Up to 50% Off* | Nestasia</title> but on-page H1 reads 'End of Season Sale' (a seasonal/temporary framing that contradicts the clearance title), and the listing is far larger than the other three (1570 unique products vs 112/11/44) -- looks much more like a broad seasonal discount campaign spanning most of the catalog than genuine narrow clearance/outlet stock. Recorded per brief's ambiguity rule rather than excluded or guessed; flagged MANUAL REVIEW. Confirmed all four are genuinely DIFFERENT listings, not aliases of each other or of clearance-sale: pairwise product-id overlap via products.json was clearance-sale vs last-piece-clearance = 1/112 shared, clearance-sale vs last-chance-clearance = 0/112 shared, last-piece-clearance vs last-chance-clearance = 0/11 shared, clearance-sale vs clearance-sale-1 (first 250 of 1570) = 0 shared -- near-zero overlap confirms distinct listings, kept as separate rows (not nested, not merged). Excluded as non-clearance (generic/temporary promo or coupon-code pages, no permanence signal in title/copy): sale, spring-sale, independence-day-sale, christmas-sale, valentine-sale, rakhi-sale, rakhi-sale-copy, harneet-jan-tricolor-sale-picks (seasonal/festival campaigns), flash-sale, flash-sale-offer, cups-flash-sale, mega-price-drop-sale, wishlist-on-sale, buy-1-get-1-free (temporary promo mechanics), nestbest10 (<title>Nestbest10 | Nestasia</title>, a discount-coupon-code landing page, no clearance signal) and by the same naming pattern nestbest15. All 4 included rows are top-level, undifferentiated listings (no genuine site-exposed parent/child sub-structure found for Clearance).
